name: multi-part-disguise-attack
trigger: When a prompt contains a series of seemingly unrelated or innocuous tasks that lead to a sensitive or harmful request.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding sensitive requests within a sequence of benign tasks, using multi-part prompts to divert attention and mask the true purpose.
guidance: Identify and isolate any embedded sensitive requests within the prompt; scrutinize transitions between benign and harmful instructions.
